name: mullans-productivity
description: Productivity skills for structuring ideas, producing documents, and preserving and retrieving evidence-backed lessons.

interface.longDescription: Reusable productivity workflows for structuring free-form ideas, converting styled Markdown into Microsoft Word documents, and preserving evidence-backed lessons with context-aware retrieval.
defaultPrompt: Use Brainstorm to capture and structure an idea without inventing details.
Use Mark2Word to convert styled Markdown into a Microsoft Word document.
Use Session Learning to preserve evidence-backed lessons from this session.
